notes:
Inbound from marketing automation tool chain — ScriptSprout builds high-volume creative variants for SMB customers. Primary ask: hosted API self-serve with predictable cost. They emphasized: 'batching & caching is huge for us — we generate hundreds of variants per campaign and many prefixes repeat.' Typical workload = daily bulk generation + some on-demand personalization calls.

Cost sensitivity: needs clear cost per 1M tokens and examples of savings from batching + prefix caching. Wants guidance on model/quantization choices to hit price targets. Prefers public cloud (no VPC for now).

Performance targets (customer stated): average latency ~300-600ms for a 128-token generation when batched; ability to sustain bursts of ~150-300 qps when batched across multiple worker threads.

Model preference: open/quantized 7B-13B family for cost/perf tradeoff; would like automatic fallback to smaller quantized model during cold-starts/bursts.

Security/compliance: SOC2 required, SSO desired but not blocker for initial POC, basic audit logging required.

POC plan: 2-week run using hosted API, dataset = 10k prompt templates x 50 variants, target 500k tokens/day. Success metrics: per-variant cost < $0.02, 95th latency within SLA, no degradation in quality vs. baseline.

Quotes / call snippets: 'If batching cuts our token spend by 30% we can justify moving fast', 'We need sample configs — how do you set batch size and prefix cache TTL?'.

Linked artifacts: pricing deck, POC configuration spreadsheet, Fireflies transcript from discovery call.
